title: Migration ledger function row -- progress fields
description: The declarative schema for the consistency-critical progress fields of a function row in a migration ledger (tools/data/<domain>_migration.json). It is the SECOND guard beside the imperative tools/migration_ledger.py validate(): the enums here MUST match that module's ALLOWED_STATES / ALLOWED_TIERS, and its self-test asserts they do, so the two cannot drift. Only `state`, `evidence_tier` and `promoted` are described here -- a row carries many other fields that are the generator's business, not this invariant's. `promoted` carries a DESCRIPTION rather than a constraint: its truth is checkable only against the source tree, which a schema cannot read, so the ratchet that enforces it is report_promotion_reconciliation.py --check-flags in lint_repo.

state.description: Lifecycle state. verified and dead are terminal; reviewed is terminal-for-now (reimpl-verify / static review only, no execution proof); the rest are in flight.

evidence_tier.description: Grades the strength of an ACCEPTED equivalence proof (T1 strongest). Meaningful ONLY on a verified row; null everywhere else. The old `static` tier was retired 2026-08-14 as redundant with state=reviewed.

promoted.description: AN INSTALLATION FACT, NOT A PROOF GRADE (settled 2026-09-10, X-PROMFLAG; docs/dead-ends.md G167). True means exactly one thing: a source TU in this tree carries an MH_EXPORT_REPLACE(<row name>, ...) -- the entry redirect whose E9 sends the original's entry to our body. It does NOT mean the body is proven (that is state+evidence_tier), does NOT mean it executes (a SHIP_PROMOTE_* key may hold the seam off; the tombstone sweep is the verdict channel), and is NOT the English sense in which a row's STATE gets promoted to verified -- that sense is what leaked into five sim rows flagged with no macro anywhere. A closure-internal row entered by a direct call from a promoted body correctly stays false. A floor on what runs, never a measurement of it.

allOf.description: INVARIANT: evidence_tier is set <=> state == verified. A verified row must carry a T1/T2/T3 tier; any other state must carry none (null or absent).
